name: Samsung NX60/NE63 Oven Temperature Sensor
purpose: Verify oven RTD at room temperature per Samsung NX60T8311 service manual — C-20/C-21 sensor fault path.
failureModes: Open (>2950 Ω): C-20 oven sensor opened
Short (<930 Ω): sensor shorted — erratic or runaway heat
1080 Ω ± at room temp is nominal at CN100 pins 11–13
testingTips: Disconnect power; measure at sensor or CN100 on Sub PCB with harness disconnected
Ro = 1000 Ω @ 0°C, RP = 2757 Ω — use OEM temp vs resistance chart for in-oven readings
notes: Samsung NX60/NE63 slide-in range — 1080 Ω at room temperature

name: Samsung NX60 Oven Bake/Broil HSI Resistance
purpose: Hot surface ignitor (HSI) cold resistance for bake and broil burners — §4-4 oven parts.
failureModes: Open (OL): no glow, oven burner will not light
In range but weak glow: verify 3.3–3.6 A at safety valve during ignition
testingTips: Disconnect power before measuring at HSI terminals
Bake voltage check T504–T505; broil T504–T503 when powered

name: Samsung NX60 Oven Door Lock Motor Coil
purpose: Self-clean door lock motor winding — C-d1 door locking information.
failureModes: Open winding: latch will not cycle — C-d1 fault
Verify AC 120 V at lock motor when lock commanded; CN300 pins 23–24 on Main PCB
testingTips: Disconnect harness from lock motor before measuring coil
Lock switch COM–NO continuity separate from motor coil

name: Samsung NX60 Convection Fan Motor Winding
purpose: Convection fan motor terminal resistance when fan not spinning.
failureModes: Open (OL): fan will not spin — check CN204 pin 1 harness and SSR200/RY204 relay
Out of range: replace burned-out fan motor
testingTips: Disconnect power; measure across fan motor terminals
Verify relay CN204 and display harness CN204/CNS701 when motor Ω is good

name: Samsung NX60 Oven Heater Relay Contacts (de-energized)
purpose: DLB, bake, and broil relay contact resistance when relays are off — C-21 overheat path.
failureModes: Low resistance (<1 kΩ) with relay off: welded/stuck relay contacts
C-21 overheat: verify DLB TB200–TB201, broil TB202–TB203, bake TB204–TB205
testingTips: Power off; remove Assy Display PCB access; measure across relay contact pairs
Normal de-energized contact reading is open (∞ Ω)
notes: Contact-side check — coil circuits are separate from this measurement

name: Samsung NX60 Oven Gas Safety Valve Current
purpose: Safety valve terminal current when HSI is glowing — opens gas to bake/broil burner.
failureModes: Low amps with glowing HSI: weak ignitor or faulty safety valve
Zero amps: open ignitor circuit or valve coil failure
testingTips: Clamp safety valve terminal during ignition after HSI glow confirmed
Verify 120 VAC at TB201–TB204 (bake) or TB201–CN202 (broil) before condemning valve

name: Samsung NX60 Oven Lamp Socket (no bulb)
purpose: Oven lamp ballast/socket with bulb removed — should read open.
failureModes: Low resistance without bulb: shorted socket or wiring fault
Open with good bulb installed: burned-out 40 W appliance bulb
testingTips: Remove bulb; measure across light ballast/socket terminals
Check CN205 harness and RY208 oven lamp relay on Main PCB
